review_notes: IMAGE-ONLY PAGE (limitation). Viewed previews/page-0020.png at full size and confirmed by eye what is printed, but the page CANNOT be faithfully transcribed: MuPDF returns 4 (two stray 'mu' glyphs only) extractable characters for this page and the extractor already recorded 'OCR unavailable or failed: FzErrorLibrary'. There is therefore no reliable native text layer, and the page is a Nature Portfolio Reporting Summary form whose meaning depends on checkbox state (crossed vs empty boxes) that a text transcription would lose. Per the review plan I KEPT THE WHOLE PAGE AS A SINGLE IMAGE and preserved mode="image"; I did NOT hand-transcribe it and I make no searchable-text claim for this page. What I changed: bbox confirmed to be the exact full MediaBox [0, 0, 612, 792] pt (note this page is US Letter, 612x792 pt, unlike the 595.276x790.866 pt article pages), and the extractor placeholder asset name 'page-0020' / label 'PDF page 20' was replaced with 'reporting-summary-page-2' / 'Reporting Summary (page 2 of 3)' so the three form pages are identifiable in the asset directory instead of being named after PDF page order. Page 2 of 3 of the Reporting Summary. Visible content: the continuation of the data availability box (PDB protein PDB:7EW9; enamine REAL database https://enamine.net), 'Research involving human participants, their data, or biological material' (all N/A), 'Field-specific reporting' (Life sciences selected) and 'Life sciences study design' (sample size, data exclusions, replication, randomization, blinding), then the header of 'Reporting for specific materials, systems and methods'.
